definition: a small vessel for travel on water
description: A young man in a yellow raincoat leans over the varnished wooden rail of a small boat, an orange life ring hanging beside him. The water is grey-green and snow-covered mountains stand on the far shore. A dark shape rises under the surface and a barnacled humpback whale lifts its head out of the water alongside the hull. The whale slips back down and leaves a wide swirl of white foam turning on the water next to the boat.

taps.phrase: to come out of the water
